text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: billing-metering-eu1 — token ingestion lag + spurious overage flags. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/billing-ingest-lag

alex: saw it at 03:00 UTC, kafka consumer group 'billing-consumers' lag jumped ~90k on partition 3. metrics: consumer_lag_{partition=3}=90213

jess: validator is emitting late_window_emit alerts and customers got automated overage emails (small cohort). Confirming affected customer IDs now.

sre-luis: i'm oncall, grabbing logs. quick ask: don't trigger any rollbacks yet. i'll scale consumer group to 6 -> 12, and pause the shadow emitter.

billing-ops: pausing shadow emitter now (PATCH: /api/emitter/pause shadow=true) — will keep production emitter running but stop shadow write to ledger.

alex: sample log from the consumer: `ERROR Commit failed: PartitionRebalanceInProgressException` then retries. consumer config shows max.poll.interval.ms=300000, last rebalance ~02:58 UTC.

sre-luis: scaled consumers, restarting consumer pod billing-consumer-3 -> new pods attached. watching lag delta.

cs-nina: heads-up: CS already saw 3 customers complaining about overage emails; I'm drafting a short message to send if we need a proactive notice.

alex: after scale, lag is down to ~12k, but we still have a backlog of inferred tokens that haven't been reconciled into daily aggregates.

sre-luis: kicking a prioritized backfill job `billing-backfill --topic billing-raw --start-offset 120000` to catch up slow partitions. backfill job is limited to low I/O rate to avoid downstream spikes.

jess: validator still reporting 1.2% of ingested events with missing epk field — could be partial schema change from the EU proxy deploy last night.

billing-ops: checking deploy history — no config deploy to emitter in last 24h, but EU proxy v2.1.7 was rolled at 01:45 UTC.

sre-luis: hold on new deploys. we need to stabilize the pipeline first. If backfill clears and missing epk persists, we'll open a model-specific investigation.

incident-bot: escalation: paging billing-sre (priority) at 03:12 UTC. Slack thread created for coordination.

alex: mitigation checklist ticked: scaled consumers, paused shadow emitter, started backfill, CS draft ready. Next: confirm reconciliation and silence noisy overage alerts.

billing-ops: temporarily muting overage notification webhook (notifications:muted=true) for EU tenants until reconciliation completes. Keeping audit trail.

cs-nina: note for customer comms: message should say "we identified delayed usage reporting causing temporary incorrect overage notifications; no actual billing was charged yet; we're replaying events and will follow up with reconciled statements."

sre-luis: backfill progress: processed ~65k messages in 10m, processing rate ~6k/s. Estimated catch-up time ~2 hours at current rate.

alex: if processing rate drops, we can spin a transient slot on dedicated infra to accelerate. need thumbs from billing-ops.

billing-ops: ok to allocate burst capacity if we hit >1.5h remaining. For now continue.

jess: putting a quiet alert on the validator to prevent paging on expected reconciliation drift: `slo:validator-late_window_emit -> warn not page` until 06:00 UTC.

cs-nina: I'll queue a proactive note to the 50 affected accounts with the canned text and a follow-up timeline.

sre-luis: handoff at 04:00 UTC to oncoming oncall (alex) — i've left backlog pointers and commands in the thread. alex pls confirm you have context.

alex: confirmed, taking post-handoff watch. Key next steps: monitor backfill completion, unmute notification webhooks only after ledger reconciled, run rolling check `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing.ledgers WHERE emit_ts BETWEEN X AND Y` to validate.

incident-bot: incident state -> mitigation in-progress, severity lowered to SEV-2 at 04:05 UTC.

billing-ops: action items created: (1) reconcile and refund if any charges were applied mistakenly (2) post-incident root cause: kafka rebalance + schema drift check (3) customer communication follow-up.

cs-nina: will hold the customer notif until we have ETA on full reconciliation. sending interim note now.

sre-luis: marking handoff complete. leaving runbook link and the backfill command in the thread. please ping if lag creeps back up.

alex: will monitor until full catch-up and then close. planning short postmortem tomorrow AM.

cs-nina: thanks team :thumbsup:
